sloka: तान्नरान् बाष्पपूर्णाक्षान् समीक्ष्याथ सुदु:खितान् ।पर्य्यष्वजत धर्मज्ञ: पितृवन्मातृवच्च स: ॥ २.१०२.४७॥
transliteration: tānnarān bāṣpapūrṇākṣān samīkṣyātha sudu:khitān ।paryyaṣvajata dharmajña: pitṛvanmātṛvacca sa: ॥ 2.102.47॥

translations.english: Thereafter, beholding those people deeply afflicted, their eyes full of tears, Rama embraced them as if they were his own father and mother.
